shortDescription: CSIR-NGRI Technician Recruitment 2026 under Advt. No. 01/2026. The recruitment portal lists 21 Technician (Gr.II(1)) vacancies. Apply online from 05 September 2026 to 04 October 2026 at 06:00 PM.
content:
CSIR-National Geophysical Research Institute (NGRI), Hyderabad has opened online applications for Technician (Gr.II(1)) posts under Advertisement No. 01/2026.

The portal lists 21 vacancies across trades including Fitter, Plumber, Electrician, Computer / IT Assistant, Digital Photographer, Laboratory Assistant-Chemical Plant, Medical Laboratory Technician, Physiotherapy Technician and Catering & Hospitality Assistant.

Online applications open on 05 September 2026 at 10:00 AM and close on 04 October 2026 at 06:00 PM. Read the detailed English or Hindi notification carefully for post-wise qualification, fee, age relaxation and selection rules.
editorNotes: Independent listing. Verify every eligibility, fee and selection detail in the official CSIR-NGRI notification before applying.
importantInstructions: The English and Hindi PDFs are official notification copies hosted on the CSIR-NGRI recruitment portal. Do not share login credentials or OTPs.
